sourceText:
Banana Nut Brownies
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, February 17, 2010 - 7:07pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup Butter or margarine, softened
1 cup Sugar
3 tablespoons Cocoa powder
2 Egg, beaten
1 tablespoon Milk
1 teaspoon Vanilla
1/2 cup Flour
1 teaspoon Baking powder
1/4 teaspoon Salt
3 mediums Banana, mashed
1/2 cup Nuts, chopped, if desired

Preparation

1 In bowl, combine butter, sugar, and cocoa. Stir in eggs, milk and vanilla. Blend in flour, baking powder, and salt. Stir in banans and nuts. Pour into a greased 9 inch square pan. Bake 350 for 40-45 min, or until done. cool. Dust with powdered sugar just before serving, if desired.
